notes.title: 🚀 Update 1.2 - Cosmetics, SFX Update, & Hands!
notes.content:
🚀 Update 1.2 is Here! 🚀

🎩 Cosmetic System Added!
✨ Up to 20 unlockable hats to collect!
💰 Find coins hidden on each level.
🛒 Visit the Cosmetic Shop through the golden button in the elevator.
🎨 Unlock new skins to customize your Dreamer!
[hr][/hr]🖐️ First Person Hands
Immersion just got a huge boost — hands are now visible in first-person view!
[hr][/hr]🔊 Sound Effects Update
💀 When you die, your character may now scream.

🧸 Your rag-doll body makes satisfying slam sounds.

📏 Rulers now… sound like actual rulers. Ruler’y as hell.
[hr][/hr]🛠️ Minor Updates
📚 On Levels 1 & 2, Lailah now teaches new Dreamers how to rotate and throw objects.

🏗️ Level 29 completely reworked (the old one was… well, let’s just say it was crap 💩).
[hr][/hr]
🔥 Jump in, try on some hats, and see how many coins you can collect!

notes.title: Fixes/Voice Chat Stability/Suit Colors/Push Your Friends
notes.content:
Fixes:
- Microphone Options Added & Voice Chat Is Much More Reliable
- Level 3 Floor Not Resetting
- You Can Now PUSH Your Friends Again!
- Purple/Pink Suits Added Just For Mely

notes.title: Update 1.1 Out Now!
notes.content:
🔥 Climb The Backrooms - Major Update LIVE NOW! 🔥

Dreamers, it's time to dive back in, right in time for the weekend!

We've just pushed a huge update packed with terrifying new content, smoother gameplay, and a few surprises lurking in the dark 👀


[carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/e8ee92f147de716692b5fe418257c68194bc227d.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/cfe1323110ad182133ae94638bb27d4494266046.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/5d359b8b481ba86286c912b8168eea8de2e2e68b.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/30554142526918ad28a3539424c6078ff7d381c6.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/905110163c4547d3188ac02e81bfd771e943b2fc.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/8fd73ed98523eae7f9ae386eb75b9afa95c79be7.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/eb2e8251be84b2f07666366e05fb050347a66186.jpg"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45674319/49ebf9e89b495a6ca31318264d7f8b31e8a347d1.jpg"][/carousel]
🆕 Patch Highlights:

📍 10 New Levels have replaced older, slower ones – faster, scarier, and way more intense

🔸 7 New Entities now haunt the halls:

💧 Water Entity

📦 Object Eater

🔋 Battery Boy

❓ Unknown Entity (x2)

☢️ Hazmat Entity

😊 Mrs. Smile – don’t let the grin fool you

🎮 New Minigames have been added to ramp up the tension and fun

😱 Loads of new jump-scares – expect the unexpected

🎥 Streamers, we got you.
New Streamer Mode is now available for a cleaner experience

🛠️ Performance & QoL Fixes:

Return to Lobby button ✅

Loading screens more consistent✅

New object pickup sounds ✅

General optimisation and smoother performance across the board



Whether you’ve played before or are new to the nightmare, there’s never been a better (or scarier) time to Climb.



//Dev Note//
If you’ve played before, now’s the perfect time to return — with Level Select in the lobby, you can dive straight into the new horrors. We’ve heard your feedback loud and clear:

⚠️ Some mid-game levels dragged.
⚠️ Some just didn’t hit the mark.

That changes now.

We’ve completely reworked the pacing and replaced slower levels with some of our best-designed, most intense stages yet. They’re faster, scarier, and packed with surprises.



Play now — if you dare.

notes.title: Sneak Peak | Update 1.1
notes.content:
Update 1.1 is shaping up to be something really exciting—and it’s coming very soon.

I’ve been working tirelessly on this next update—without rushing it, of course. There are some seriously fun and terrifying new additions on the way: new entities that’ll chase you down and scare the absolute life out of you, plus a full rework of nine maps that are being completely redesigned from the ground up.

Your feedback—good, bad, or brutal—is always appreciated and plays a big role in shaping each patch.

If you’ve already played the game, I promise it’ll be worth coming back once this juicy update drops. I’d love to share some videos, but I don’t want to spoil too much just yet 😏

Here are a few pics and a little gif to give you a taste.
